remarks: This immaculate transitional colonial has it all.... exceptional detailing, high-quality finishes, energy star certified with an open concept for today's living. The prime location is just minutes to the train, the village of Saugatuck, Longshore, the beach and downtown Westport. Move right in to this 5 bedroom, 5 full and 2 half bath home, complete with a fenced yard. Finished on four floors, this home allows everyone to have their own space. The first floor includes a spacious chef's kitchen, dining area, family room with gas fireplace, dining room, powder room, mudroom, an a large pantry. The primary bedroom suite, spa like bathroom and custom walk-in-closet are sure to delight. Three additional generous sized bedrooms with en-suite baths and a laundry room round out the second floor. The third floor offers many possibilities bonus/playroom, homework or hang out room with a full bath, a 5th bedroom which is currently utilized as a home office. The finished lower-level media room, half bath, gym, and storage space offer lots of versatility. Welcome to 36 Bridge Street and Westport for an idyllic lifestyle
